title: Apnea Events by Sleep Position
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cpap:session
| search sleep_position=* apnea_events=*
| stats avg(apnea_events) as avg_apnea_events avg(mask_leak_lpm) as avg_mask_leak_lpm by sleep_position
| sort - avg_apnea_events
description: Examines apnea events by sleep position.
value: Position splits can show whether therapy problems are mostly positional instead of purely equipment-driven.
implementation: Send apnea events by sleep position events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of apnea events by sleep position, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It frames what is happening with apnea events by sleep position, so odd changes stand out quickly.
